verdict.rationale: Inline completions and next-edit suggestions are a fair question for an AI coding tool, but the evidence never shows Claude Code offering as-you-type completions. Its IDE integrations only document inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and diff viewing for agent-proposed changes, which is an adjacent feature. The core workflow is natural-language tasking, not typing-time suggestions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
